changes: Cartridge reads now use a small cached lookup, giving the browser about 3.16% more processing headroom across six tested games without changing game timing.
In busy scrolling, sprite-heavy scenes with music and the LCD shader enabled, that extra room helps keep audio, input and presentation responsive.
The measured gain was positive in all six games: +1.98% to +3.90%, with identical final game checksums.
All 58 project checks still pass, including BIOS startup, mapper and RTC behaviour, save states, cartridge loading and the standalone build.
The DMG reference score and CGB audio score are unchanged; the larger revision-accuracy work remains reserved for v3.0.0.
